name: Hurt Angel
source:
One snowy morning while walking to work, you come across an angel who needs your help with a simple task. Won't you help him?

[From [url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/hurt-angel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个下雪的早晨，当你步行去上班时，你遇到了一位天使，他需要你帮助完成一项简单的任务。你不帮他吗？
